title: API gateway: adjust routing rules, streaming proxy buffers and payload limits (OpenAI compat)
author: Anita Patel
description: Motivation: We observed intermittent streaming stalls and degraded function-calling payloads under high-concurrency workloads. This PR tightens routing fallbacks, increases streaming proxy buffer capacity for larger chunked responses, and enforces payload size limits for OpenAI-compat endpoints to avoid head-of-line blocking. Changes are focused to avoid breaking existing clients while improving stability and preserving OpenAI compatibility semantics. Summary of changes: 1) routing: add explicit prefer-low-latency route rule for short-response workloads and introduce a fallback window (50ms) before hitting cost-tier fallbacks; 2) streaming proxy: increase internal buffer from 64KB->256KB, add backpressure accounting per-client and a proactive flush for final chunk to reduce tail stalls; 3) payload limits: enforce 10MB request payload limit on /v1/compat endpoints and return structured OpenAI-style error (413) with retry guidance; 4) function/tool-calling: ensure structured output chunks include call metadata headers, and update compat layer to surface tool-calls as "tool_call" events consistent with upstream OpenAI semantics; 5) docs and migration: add compatibility notes and a runtime feature flag (api.gateway.buffer_tuning_v2) to gate rollout. Backwards compatibility: default routes and legacy payload paths are unchanged; OpenAI-compat endpoints gain stricter validation but return documented errors. Testing: unit tests for routing priority, integration tests that simulate high-concurrency streaming sessions, and e2e compatibility test for function-calling payloads. Rollout: feature-flagged rollout with staged percentage and emergency rollback via runtime config. Linear/Related: ENG-3142, ENG-3298. See linked CI for perf regressions and integration test results.

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we make the buffer size configurable via runtime flag? In high-throughput clusters 256KB might increase memory pressure.
Anita Patel: Added api.gateway.buffer_tuning_v2 flag and limited default worker-local buffer allocation. Will monitor memory graphs during rollout.
Priya Singh: The fallback window looks okay, but please ensure metrics are emitted when we hit fallback to the cost tier (routing.fallback.count).
Anita Patel: Emitted routing.fallback.count and added a dashboard link in the PR description for SRE to observe during rollout.
Eve Zhang: Integration test fails on first run due to race in proxy flush; fixed with a small mutex around final chunk flush.
release_notes: Improved streaming stability: increased proxy buffer and backpressure, tightened routing fallbacks for low-latency workloads, and enforced 10MB request payload limit for OpenAI compatibility endpoints. Feature-flagged rollout; see openai_compat.md for migration notes.
notes_for_ops: Watch metrics: routing.fallback.count, proxy.buffer.alloc_bytes, proxy.stream.tail_latency_ms, api.compat.payload_rejected. Rollout via api.gateway.buffer_tuning_v2 feature flag; emergency rollback by disabling flag.
testing_summary: Unit tests for routing and limits; integration test simulating 500 concurrent streaming clients; e2e test verifying function-calling structured output and 413 error semantics for oversized payloads. CI showed one flaky test which was rerun and passed.
impact_summary: Immediate improvement in streaming tail latencies under concurrent load and clearer errors for oversized compat requests. Minimal risk due to feature flag and documented behavior.
